items.title_cn: OpenAI’s revenue is reportedly $20 billion less than previously projected
items.title_en: OpenAI’s revenue is reportedly $20 billion less than previously projected
items.summary_cn: It had previously been reported that the AI lab's annualized revenue was some $70 billion, but a new report claims it's a whole lot less than that.
items.summary_en: It had previously been reported that the AI lab's annualized revenue was some $70 billion, but a new report claims it's a whole lot less than that.

items.title_cn: Google brings agentic AI to Gemini, starting with businesses
items.title_en: Google brings agentic AI to Gemini, starting with businesses
items.summary_cn: Google is turning Gemini into an AI agent that can plan, execute tasks, and work across business apps and systems. The agent can delegate work to subagents, use multiple AI models, and even gets its own workplace identity, complete with an email address.
items.summary_en: Google is turning Gemini into an AI agent that can plan, execute tasks, and work across business apps and systems. The agent can delegate work to subagents, use multiple AI models, and even gets its own workplace identity, complete with an email address.

items.title_cn: Anthropic changes usage policy to ban model abuse and election interference
items.title_en: Anthropic changes usage policy to ban model abuse and election interference
items.summary_cn: Anthropic's updated usage policy explicitly prohibits users from repeatedly abusing Claude in extreme cases, though ordinary frustration and criticism are still allowed. The new rules also address election interference, deceptive campaigns, weapons software, and surveillance.
